title: PsyMemBehav: Psychology-Informed and Memory-Grounded Two-Level Identity-to-Action Reasoning for Social-Media Behavior Simulation
abstract: arXiv:2610.14570v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) support social simulation, but faithfully reproducing real users requires grounding both structured platform decisions and language in sparse, noisy behavioral evidence. We introduce PsyMemBehav, which maps psychology-informed profiles and retrieved memories to target-first platform behavior through two-level identity-to-action reasoning. To support this approach with comprehensive behavioral traces, we construct a dataset PsyMemBehav-bench from 5.57M observed behaviors of 5,862 real users (approximately 950 per user) across Reddit, Bluesky, and Twitter. Each recorded engagement is modeled as target selection followed by Comment, Like, or Repost and optional response generation. PsyMemBehav combines 41-dimensional user descriptors, top-5 BM25 memories, reverse-CoT supervision, and rubric-guided DPO over complete reasoning-action trajectories. translated_title: PsyMemBehav：基于心理学信息与记忆支撑的双层“身份到行动”推理社交媒体行为模拟
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）支持社会模拟，但要忠实地复现真实用户，需要将结构化的平台决策和语言表达都建立在稀疏、嘈杂的行为证据之上。我们提出了PsyMemBehav，它通过两层“身份到行动”的推理，将心理学信息驱动的用户画像与检索到的记忆映射为“先选目标”的平台行为。为了用全面的行为轨迹支撑这一方法，我们基于5,862名真实用户在Reddit、Bluesky和Twitter上的557万条观测行为（平均每名用户约950条）构建了数据集PsyMemBehav-bench。每条记录的互动行为都被建模为“先选择目标对象，随后进行评论、点赞或转发，并可选地生成回应内容”。PsyMemBehav结合了41维用户描述符、Top-5 BM25检索记忆、反向思维链监督，以及在完整“推理-行动”轨迹上基于评分准则的DPO训练。实验表明，PsyMemBehav 27B在12项报告的评估中有11项排名第一。
tldr: 提出PsyMemBehav框架，通过心理学画像与检索记忆支撑的双层“身份到行动”推理，在包含5,862名真实用户、557万条行为的新基准上更忠实地模拟真实用户的社交媒体行为。
en_tdlr: PsyMemBehav performs two-level identity-to-action reasoning grounded in psychology-informed profiles and retrieved memories to faithfully simulate real users' social media behaviors, supported by a new benchmark built from 5.57M behaviors of 5,862 real users across Reddit, Bluesky, and Twitter.
